vocabulary.meaning: Something that happened in your life

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ ऐसा जो आपके जीवन में हुआ
meaning_translation.Japanese: 自分の人生で起こったこと

examples.sentence: I had a great experience on my trip to Japan.

translation.Hindi: जापान की यात्रा में मेरा शानदार अनुभव रहा।
translation.Japanese: 日本旅行で素晴らしい経験をしました。

meaning_translation.Japanese: ワクワクするまたは珍しい経験

examples.sentence: Climbing the mountain was a real adventure.

translation.Hindi: पहाड़ पर चढ़ना एक असली साहसिक अनुभव था।
translation.Japanese: 山登りは本当の冒険でした。

vocabulary.meaning: To bring a past event back into your mind

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी पिछले घटना को फिर से अपने मन में लाना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 過去の出来事を思い出すこと

examples.sentence: I remember the first time I rode a bicycle.

translation.Hindi: मुझे याद है जब मैंने पहली बार साइकिल चलाई।
translation.Japanese: 初めて自転車に乗ったときを覚えています。

meaning_translation.Japanese: 何かを覚えていないこと

examples.sentence: I will never forget my first day at school.

translation.Hindi: मैं अपने स्कूल का पहला दिन कभी नहीं भूलूंगा।
translation.Japanese: 学校の初日を決して忘れません。

vocabulary.meaning: Something that makes you feel happy and interested

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ ऐसा जो आपको खुश और उत्साहित महसूस कराए
meaning_translation.Japanese: 楽しく興味を持たせるもの

examples.sentence: It was an exciting story about their trip.

translation.Hindi: यह उनकी यात्रा की एक रोमांचक कहानी थी।
translation.Japanese: それは彼らの旅行についてのわくわくする話でした。

vocabulary.meaning: Making you feel shy or uncomfortable

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ ऐसा जो आपको शर्मिंदा या असहज कर दे
meaning_translation.Japanese: 恥ずかしかったり、不快にさせるもの

examples.sentence: Falling in front of everyone was embarrassing.

translation.Japanese: みんなの前で転んだのは恥ずかしかったです。

vocabulary.meaning: To tell a story or describe events

meaning_translation.Hindi: कहानी सुनाना या घटनाओं का वर्णन करना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 物語や出来事を語ること

examples.sentence: She narrated the story of her childhood.

translation.Hindi: उसने अपने बचपन की कहानी सुनाई।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は子供時代の話を語りました。

meaning_translation.Japanese: 経験から得られた教訓

examples.sentence: The lesson learned was to always be prepared.

translation.Hindi: सीखा हुआ सबक यह था कि हमेशा तैयार रहना चाहिए।
translation.Japanese: 学んだ教訓は常に準備することでした。

grammar_tips.title: Starting a story with 'One day…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'One day…' to begin telling a past story. Example: One day, we went to the beach.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'One day…' कहकर किसी पुरानी कहानी की शुरुआत करें। उदाहरण: One day, we went to the beach.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 過去の話を始めるとき「One day…」を使います。例: One day, we went to the beach.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'I remember…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I remember…' to introduce a past event. Example: I remember my first flight.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'I remember…' कहकर कोई पुरानी घटना बताएं। उदाहरण: I remember my first flight.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 過去の出来事を言うとき「I remember…」を使います。例: I remember my first flight.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'I will never forget…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I will never forget…' for something important or emotional. Example: I will never forget my graduation day.

explanation_translation.Hindi: महत्वपूर्ण या भावुक घटना के लिए 'I will never forget…' कहें। उदाहरण: I will never forget my graduation day.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 大切または感情的な出来事に「I will never forget…」を使います。例: I will never forget my graduation day.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'It was…' to describe feelings
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'It was…' with adjectives like exciting, scary, embarrassing. Example: It was an exciting trip.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'It was…' का प्रयोग विशेषणों (exciting, scary, embarrassing) के साथ करें। उदाहरण: It was an exciting trip.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 「It was…」の後に形容詞を使って気持ちを表します。例: It was an exciting trip.

grammar_tips.title: Ending with 'The lesson I learned…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'The lesson I learned…' to finish the story with meaning. Example: The lesson I learned was to be careful.

explanation_translation.Hindi: कहानी को सार्थक रूप से खत्म करने के लिए 'The lesson I learned…' कहें। उदाहरण: The lesson I learned was to be careful.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 話を意味のある形で終えるとき「The lesson I learned…」を使います。例: The lesson I learned was to be careful.
